picks.headline: AI와 양자화학을 엮어 효율적인 청색 OLED 소재를 찾다
picks.excerpt: Nagoya University researchers combined machine learning with quantum chemistry to hunt for efficient blue OLED materials, training a model on quantum-chemistry data for 1,000 molecules and then screening more than 17,000 candidates. The AI slashed computational cost and surfaced promising emitters that were then validated experimentally, showing generative screening can accelerate materials discovery.
picks.rationale: Generative ML + quantum-chemistry screen of 17,000+ molecules, with hits validated experimentally — a concrete materials-discovery method; no URL or content match in published science history.

picks.headline: 물리 법칙을 실시간으로 검증하는 AI가 산란 매질 너머를 본다
picks.excerpt: UCLA researchers built DeepTimeGate, a physics-informed machine-learning framework that images through scattering media by pairing a reconstruction network with a second algorithm that enforces the fundamental rules of physics as a real-time reality check. The method enables high-quality imaging with low-cost cameras, with uses in biomedical imaging and autonomous-vehicle sensing.
picks.rationale: Physics-as-a-guardrail architecture (DeepTimeGate) lets low-cost cameras image through scatter — actionable for biomedical and autonomous sensing; net-new, distinct topic from the OLED pick.

picks.headline: 양자 기하학으로 양자 AI의 '치명적 망각'을 막다
picks.excerpt: Researchers introduced QEWC, a quantum machine-learning framework that uses quantum geometry to stop 'catastrophic forgetting'—the tendency of models to lose earlier skills when trained on new tasks. By anchoring learning to the geometry of quantum states, quantum AI systems can retain what they have learned across sequential tasks.
picks.rationale: Novel geometry-anchored fix for continual-learning forgetting in quantum ML, from a credible quantum-focused outlet — distinct topic and a third outlet for diversity.
